sections.heading: Abstract
sections.text: We introduce TinyMoE, a sparse retriever. It reaches 85.3% recall@10 on BEIR.

sections.heading: 1 Introduction
sections.text: Dense retrievers are costly to run on long documents.

sections.heading: 2 Method
sections.text: The router is a linear layer with 1,024 hidden units.

sections.heading: 3 Experiments
sections.text:
Model	Recall@10
BM25	71.2
TinyMoE	$85.3$
TinyMoE improves recall by 14.1 points over BM25 while using 3.2× less compute.
